user.title: Paste a Claim Link
user.description: A Parent sends one from the app: Settings, then an Invite for a Hub. Paste the whole link — it carries the address of your deployment and the token.

data_description.claim_link: The whole URL, exactly as it arrived.

reauth_confirm.title: This panel has been signed out
reauth_confirm.description: A Parent mints a Rescue Link in the app — Settings, beside the pending invites — for this panel's Member. Paste it here, the same way a lost phone is signed back in.

data_description.claim_link: The whole URL, exactly as it arrived.

confirm.title: Claim this link

confirm_unnamed.title: Claim this link

error.link_expired: That link has expired. A Parent can mint a fresh one in Settings.
error.link_used: That link has already been claimed. If that was not you, check the pending links in Settings.
error.link_burnt: That link has been revoked. A Parent can mint a fresh one in Settings.
error.link_unknown: That is not a Claim Link.
error.not_baby_log_book: That address does not answer like a Baby Log Book server.
error.http_public_origin: A public address must use HTTPS. Plain http:// is only allowed on a home network.
error.hosting_paused: Hosting is paused for that Household. A Parent can resume it, then try again.
error.server_too_old: That deployment runs Baby Log Book {server}. This panel needs {minimum} or newer.

abort.already_configured: This Household is already on this Home Assistant. A second wall panel is a second Home Assistant, not a second entry.
abort.wrong_member: That link was for {name}, not for this panel's Member. It has been discarded. Ask a Parent for a Rescue Link for the Hub's Member.
abort.reauth_successful: The panel is signed back in.

log_bottle_feed.name: Log a bottle feed
log_bottle_feed.description: Logs a bottle for the Baby whose device you target.

volume_ml.name: Volume
volume_ml.description: How much went into the bottle, in millilitres.

leftover_ml.name: Leftover
leftover_ml.description: What came back in the bottle, if the feed is already over. The app's own sheet no longer asks for this.

log_nappy.name: Log pee & poop
log_nappy.description: Logs a pee, a poop or both for the Baby whose device you target — one entry, because they are two facts about one event.

member_removed.title: Baby Log Book: this panel has been unplugged
member_removed.description: The Hub's Member has been removed from {household}, so this panel has stopped reading and writing. Everything it logged stays with its name on it. There is no signing back in: removal burns the Rescue Links. To reconnect, a Parent sends a fresh Invite for a Hub and you add Baby Log Book again.

hosting_paused.title: Baby Log Book: hosting is paused
hosting_paused.description: Hosting for {household} is paused, so the panel is showing nothing rather than something stale. A Parent can resume it; the panel picks up again on its own.

integration_outdated.title: Baby Log Book: update the integration
integration_outdated.description: The server said something this version of the integration cannot read. Update Baby Log Book in HACS. This build speaks to servers from {minimum} upwards.

outbox_full.message: This panel has {limit} presses still waiting to reach the server, so it did not take another one. It keeps trying; nothing queued is lost.

not_a_baby.message: That device is not a Baby ({device_id}). Target the Baby's device.

entry_not_loaded.message: Baby Log Book is not loaded for that device ({device_id}).
